Message:
test(release): track F1/F2 remediation and R3-R7 release evidence

Close the R8/A6 repository-identity blocker by committing the accepted
implementation and evidence suites. No production redesign.

F1 - deployment contract (MIGRATE -> VERIFY SCHEMA -> START)
- Dockerfile and compose probe /health/ready, not liveness, so an
  unmigrated or degraded gateway cannot report itself healthy
- docker-compose.yml adds the one-shot sabiroute-migrate service; the API
  waits on service_completed_successfully
- docs/deployment.md and README describe the explicit migration step

F2 - schema validation
- check_schema requires sabiroute_accounting_lineages, so a database
  missing the accounting-lineage table fails closed instead of passing

Evidence suites (21 new files)
- F1/F2: deployment migration contract, schema groups, schema validators
- R3: BYOK boundary, persistence isolation, off-loop boundary,
  real-service controls, secret leakage, config credential policy
- R4/F-27: accounting lineage, admin lineage HTTP, admission concurrency,
  compatibility state, Redis continuity, rollback injection
- R5/R7: deterministic reliability, fallback injection, request limits,
  recovery/shutdown, chat session hygiene, shared rate-limit backend

Gates: ruff check src tests scripts config clean; mypy src clean
(49 files); git diff --check clean; suite green offline
(663 passed / 9 skipped) and with real PostgreSQL
(667 passed / 5 Redis-gated skips).
